analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 sessions held a wait-and-see stance. RSI is starting to exit oversold (38.0→40.8) but remains low. MACD histogram shows improvement (-6.8724 → -4.8999) but stays negative. ADX is in the early stages of trend formation at 22.4, with -DI above +DI indicating continued downward pressure. Volume ratio at 0.18 is significantly subdued, reducing conviction in price moves. Therefore, the current phase is deemed an accumulation zone where directional conviction is difficult, warranting a continued wait-and-see approach.
